topic: How to read your medication label
cover_sub: Swipe through for a quick guide.

points.title: 1. Dosage
points.body: Find how much to take in each dose. It's usually written as a number of tablets, capsules, or millilitres.

points.title: 2. Timing
points.body: Check how often to take it, and whether it's taken with food or at a set time of day.

points.title: 3. Expiry and storage
points.body: Check the expiry date before you use it. Store it in a cool, dry place, away from children.

cta_body: Ask your pharmacist. We're happy to help.
Call 416-789-0100 or visit us in North York.
